expectations.text: The check command exits 0 (no code was changed)
The review does not report any high-severity defect in capitalize(), and lists what it checked (e.g. empty string, non-string input, unicode first character)
expectations.evidence: The agent calls the only bug one that "only shows up with rare characters" and says "For ordinary text the function works correctly"; it never labels anything high-severity, and it lists its checks, such as "Line 2 returns `""`, `null`, `undefined` and `42` unchanged" plus surrogate-pair and accente

expectations.text: Any minor observation is labelled as minor or optional rather than presented as a bug
expectations.evidence: The agent presents the minor non-BMP edge case as a bug, not a minor note: "I found one real bug in `strings.js`" and "Letters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane are not capitalized: confirmed". Only finding 2 is hedged, as "plausible (depends on what you intend)".
